### 图例/说明（底部框）
- Green  On track
- Yellow
  - Timeline: 1-3 months delay or potential delay; or
  - Operational issue: slow enrollment, retention rate lower than plan; or
  - Quality: 3 major site audit observations, inspection readiness with significant issues; major NC report
  - Issue/delay caused by local reasons
- Red
  - Timeline: > 3 months delay; or
  - Operational issue: major enrollment delay, significantly poor retention; or
  - Not meeting primary end point; or
  - Quality: ≥ 1 critical and/or ≥ 4 major site audit observations; inspection readiness with critical issues; critical NC report
  - Issue/delay caused by local reasons
- Issue/delay caused by global reasons only（对应空心圆图示，颜色在图中显示但文字为此行）
- Issue/delay caused by global reasons only（第二行同句，另一种空心圆图示）

### 底部状态/优先级文字
- Traffic light status:
- ★ OneHP Priority
- ★ TA Priority
- Presentation title | ONLY FOR INTERNAL USE

## 视觉关系

- 页面按治疗领域分区：Obesity、Liver Disease、Chronic Kidney Disease、Cardiovascular Disease、Others；每个分区上方配有“Project Count”饼图与“Study Count”柱状图，对应该领域的项目/研究数量分布。
- 每个领域内的项目以列表形式呈现；每个项目下方用横条展示不同研究（每条横条以“Phase + study编号 + study类型/描述”呈现）。
- 横条左侧的圆点/空心圆与底部图例对应，用于标记项目/研究的状态（Green/Yellow/Red及“global reasons only”的两种空心标记）。
- 绿色箭头（右指）出现在部分研究横条左侧，用于强调这些条目（箭头指向对应的研究横条）。
- “★”符号用于标识优先级：底部图例将★对应到“OneHP Priority”和“TA Priority”；页面中部分项目名称前带★，表示其属于相应优先级标记体系。
